name: appfactory
description: The App Factory — turn an app idea into a signed, installed, verified-running Android APK, from a terminal, with or without a local Android SDK. Every check in it was derived from a failure that actually shipped.

plugins.name: appfactory-core
plugins.description: The Android build-and-verify pipeline. Owns the runtime vendored into your repo (preflight checks with fixtures, the stage ledger, the secrets vault), and the guard hooks that make three documented repeat failures structurally impossible: an unpinned CI run lookup, a push that skipped preflight, and writing signing material into the tree.
